sources.snippet: This example shows how to run inference using TensorFlow Lite Micro (TFLM) on two models for wake-word recognition. The first model is an audio preprocessor that generates spectrogram data from raw audio samples. The second is the Micro Speech model, a less than 20 kB model that can recognize 2 keywords, "yes" and "no", from speech data. The Micro Speech model takes the spectrogram data as ...
